svg.title: Design sheet · Flower crown, vine and cheek cluster
svg.text: Design sheet · Flower crown, vine and cheek cluster
Trace the gray outlines: a flower crown with a vine (left) and a cheek cluster (right). Lessons 04.1 and project 3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Order: sponge glow, petals, leaves and vines, centers, thin outline, white highlights.
